object.attr: derived: CF-S19, D14, review Q17, and the Compare code review's V22. A crafted branch could make Mellon show, return or export a file outside the repository, or block on a pipe or device. Decided on 2026-11-10. Accepted on 2026-11-13 as a security fix after the code view (CV-TRACE-07: a document folder that was a link to another project made that project's objects show as incoming links and in traces); to confirm with the person (open question Q20).
object.description: If a document's folder or an entry inside the folder is a symbolic link, junction, pipe, socket or device, Mellon shall report a load error for the document without opening that entry.
